title: Warren Buffett skill - data structure
description: Complete data contract for the warren-buffett skill. `input` is the JSON object the agent receives in the user message (built by gather_stock_data in api/index.py). `output` is the JSON object the agent must return; the API enforces it with structured outputs and the server-side price rules. Missing input fields are omitted rather than nulled: the agent must list them under output.data_gaps and must never estimate them as if known.

conventions.currency: Prices and valuation outputs are in the stock's trading currency (input.fundamentals.currency). Statement figures are in input.fundamentals.financialCurrency, which can differ (e.g. a TSX listing reporting in USD).
conventions.ratios: Fundamentals ratios from Yahoo Finance are fractions unless stated (returnOnEquity 0.35 = 35%). debtToEquity is a percentage (150 = 150%). dividendYield's unit has changed between yfinance versions; treat it as a percentage if > 1, otherwise a fraction, and say which was assumed.
conventions.signs: Cash-flow statement outflows are negative as reported (Capital Expenditure, Repurchase Of Capital Stock, Cash Dividends Paid).
conventions.dates: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Statement columns are fiscal year-ends keyed by the year ("2025").

sources.price: Azure SQL dbo.stock_prices (two years of daily OHLCV loaded from Yahoo Finance), or a direct Yahoo Finance download when the symbol is not loaded. input.price.source says which.
sources.fundamentals: Yahoo Finance quote summary via yfinance (Ticker.info).
sources.annual_statements: Yahoo Finance annual statements via yfinance (income_stmt, balance_sheet, cashflow), typically the last four fiscal years.

minimum_useful_input: at least two fiscal years of annual_statements.income.Net Income and annual_statements.cashflow.Free Cash Flow (or Operating Cash Flow and Capital Expenditure)

symbol.description: Ticker as used by Yahoo Finance, upper case (AAPL, RY.TO, ^GSPTSE).

analysis_date.description: Date the analysis is run; use as 'today' for horizons and staleness.

source_note.description: Provenance note for fundamentals and statements.

price.description: Snapshot derived from daily closes. Context on where the price sits; not a decision input under the Buffett approach.

as_of.description: Date of the last stored close.

last_close.description: Last daily close; the 'current price' for the verdict.

high_52w.description: Highest daily high in the last 252 trading days.

low_52w.description: Lowest daily low in the last 252 trading days.

ma200.description: 200-day simple moving average of close; null if fewer than 200 rows.

return_1y_pct.description: Price return over the last 252 trading days, percent.

annualized_volatility_pct.description: Std. dev. of daily returns over 252 days * sqrt(252) * 100.

max_drawdown_1y_pct.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline in the last year, percent (<= 0).

source.description: Where the price history came from.

fundamentals.description: Yahoo Finance quote-summary fields. Only fields Yahoo returned are present.

currency.description: Trading currency of the listing (ISO 4217). All output prices use this.

financialCurrency.description: Reporting currency of the financial statements.

enterpriseValue.description: Market cap + debt - cash, trading currency.

currentPrice.description: Yahoo's latest price; may differ slightly from price.last_close (intraday vs close).

forwardPE.description: Price / consensus next-12-month EPS (analyst estimate, not company data).

returnOnEquity.description: Net income / shareholders' equity, trailing, as a fraction. Key moat indicator (Buffett looks for > 0.15 sustained without heavy leverage).

debtToEquity.description: Total debt / equity as a PERCENTAGE (e.g. 45.2).

totalCash.description: Cash and short-term investments, financial currency.

freeCashflow.description: Trailing free cash flow (operating cash flow - capex), financial currency. Starting point for owner earnings.

revenueGrowth.description: Latest quarter revenue growth year-over-year, fraction.

earningsGrowth.description: Latest quarter earnings growth year-over-year, fraction.

grossMargins.description: Fraction. Stability over time indicates pricing power.

sharesOutstanding.description: Current shares outstanding. Compare with annual_statements.balance['Ordinary Shares Number'] for buyback/dilution trend.

bookValue.description: Book value PER SHARE, financial currency.

beta.description: 5-year monthly beta vs the market. Context only; not a Buffett input.

heldPercentInsiders.description: Fraction of shares held by insiders; a management-alignment signal.

longBusinessSummary.description: Company description. Primary input for the circle-of-competence and moat judgments.

annual_statements.description: Selected line items from the annual statements, each as {fiscal year: value}. A row is absent if Yahoo did not report it; a year is null if that year is missing.

Total Revenue.description: Revenue by fiscal year. Trend and consistency matter more than level.

Net Income.description: Earnings by year; with equity gives historical ROE, with shares gives EPS growth.

Diluted EPS.description: Per-share earnings; growth rate is the ceiling for valuation growth assumptions.

Interest Expense.description: With Operating Income gives interest coverage.

Stockholders Equity.description: With Net Income gives ROE by year; trend shows retained-earnings compounding.

Ordinary Shares Number.description: Shares outstanding at year-end; falling = buybacks, rising = dilution.

Capital Expenditure.description: Negative as reported. Separate maintenance from growth capex by judgment and list it as an assumption.

Free Cash Flow.description: Operating cash flow + capital expenditure (which is negative).

Depreciation And Amortization.description: Owner earnings = Net Income + D&A - maintenance capex.

Repurchase Of Capital Stock.description: Negative = cash spent on buybacks. Judge against intrinsic value at the time.

yearSeries.description: Fiscal-year keyed values in the financial currency.

headline.description: One-sentence conclusion stating the recommendation and the main reason.

summary.description: Two to four paragraphs supporting the decision.

output_rules_enforced_by_server: recommendation BUY requires target_price and stop_price (non-null); the run is rejected otherwise.
recommendation SELL requires target_price (non-null); the run is rejected otherwise.
Warnings (not rejections): BUY with stop_price >= current_price, target_price <= current_price, or current_price > buy_below_price; SELL with target_price >= current_price or a non-null stop_price.
